title: Refine keyboard, paste and validation flow for compound form fields (date/time/address parts)
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Compound form fields (examples: date broken into DD / MM / YYYY, time inputs with hours/minutes/AM-PM, and multi-part address fields) behave inconsistently across products. Issues observed: inconsistent auto-advance, confusing paste behavior, unpredictable validation ordering (sub-field vs group-level messages), and keyboard navigation that breaks expected arrow/backspace semantics. This leads to accessibility friction for screen reader and keyboard-only users and causes support tickets when users paste ISO/locale date strings.

Goal: Define a single, accessible, developer-friendly pattern for compound inputs that covers keyboard navigation, paste normalization, focus management, validation precedence, and design tokens for spacing/focus/error states. Provide final specs and a small component reference (TextFieldComposite / DatePartsInput) the engineering team can implement with minimal interpretation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Keyboard arrow movement: Left/Right move caret across subfields; Shift+Arrow selects within subfield; Home/End move within and across correctly. 2) Backspace at start of subfield moves focus to previous subfield and deletes last char. 3) Paste: Pasting entire valid value (e.g., 2025-03-12 or 03/12/2025) distributes and normalizes into subfields; invalid characters ignored; partial paste fills forwards. 4) Auto-advance: Subfields auto-advance on full valid subfield content but should not steal input when user is selecting. 5) Validation: Inline subfield validation shows low-priority warnings (format) while group-level validation shows primary errors (impossible date); group-level error is announced by SR first. 6) Tokens: spacing, focus, and error color tokens mapped to design system variables. 7) Tests: Include unit + a11y e2e tests and screen reader walkthroughs.
design_notes: Proposed component: DatePartsInput (props: aria-label, locale, autoAdvance, pasteMode="smart"/"block" ) with an internal model that exposes: getValue(), setValue(normalized), focusPart(index). Visual rules: 8px inter-part horizontal gap (token: token-input-part-gap), shared border radius on group vs separated parts in compact density, single focus ring that appears around active part and group highlight on focus-within. Error state: group-level red500 token + subfield underline red300. Microcopy guideline: Use helper text for expected input formats when locale ambiguous (e.g., MM/DD vs DD/MM).
decisions: Use a single group container with role=group and aria-labelledby where possible so SR can read field label once
Group-level aria-invalid true when any subfield fails semantic validation (eg. month>12 or invalid day for month)
Announce subfield-level format hints via aria-describedby but announce group-level errors using assertive live region on blur or submit
Auto-advance enabled by default but disabled if user types separator explicitly (user intent preserved)
Paste behavior: default to smart parsing that recognizes common delimiters and ISO format; engineers to use parsing util (ENG-5017)
Left/right arrow should honor RTL locales (direction-aware)

implementation_notes: Engineering will need to coordinate on: input masking vs normalization library (ENG-5017), per-locale parsing rules (use CLDR shortlist), and exposing small imperative API for focus control. Plan to land as new component to avoid regressing legacy DateInput; then provide adapter wrapper for forms library used by product teams.
risks: Parsing edge-cases for non-Gregorian locales — fallback to single text field if locale unsupported
Auto-advance might reduce discoverability for users editing earlier parts — mitigated by disabling auto-advance on paste and when user inserts separators
Implementation complexity across browsers (input event ordering) — require cross-browser e2e tests
reviews_and_feedback: PM review (Lindsey Chen): prefer conservative auto-advance for high-risk flows (DOB) — agreed to opt-out via prop
Engineering review (Tariq Hassan): flagged need for normalization util; ENG task ENG-5017 created
Accessibility review (Maya Singh): requested assertive announcement for group-level errors and explicit role mapping — implemented in decisions
Design review (Nina Rodriguez): suggested visual emphasis on first invalid subfield when group-level error present
qa_plan: 1) Unit tests for part parsing/normalization and autoAdvance behavior. 2) Cypress end-to-end scenarios: typing, arrow navigation, backspace across parts, paste full/partial examples, screen reader test with NVDA/VoiceOver using axe. 3) Cross-browser smoke on Chrome, Safari, Firefox. 4) Regression checklist to compare behaviour with legacy DateInput.
rollout_plan: Build component behind feature flag for 2 weeks, migrate one product surface (settings DOB) first, collect telemetrics for input correction rates and keyboard navigation errors, then flip flag and provide adapter for other teams.
